name: always-on-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the user-scope baseline — project-agnostic plugins worth enabling once in ~/.claude/settings.json and keeping on in every repo. Two write-time guards (command-guard's destructive-command deny, secret-scanning's secret block), candor's honesty Stop gate, lean's output pricing, file-aware skill auto-routing (skill-router), git-workflow discipline, cross-session friction mining (hindsight), and plugin-scout to suggest the per-project plugins this bundle deliberately leaves out. The membership rule is prose, not script-checked. Uninstall cleanly with /always-on-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
